properties.name: Isle of Kortos
properties.text: Island home of Absalom and the Starstone. The City at the Center of the World rules the isle; Aroden remains active in this era.

properties.name: Absalom
properties.text: Ruling city of the Isle of Kortos and the City at the Center of the World. In this campaign era, Aroden is still active and tied directly into Absalom politics.

properties.name: Monster
properties.text: A settled and unexpectedly stable goblin nation ruled by the Goblin King — He Who Sits and Does Not Move. Its border with Taldor remains surprisingly peaceful. In published history this land later becomes Andoran; not here, and not yet.
properties.tags: Goblin Kingdom, Current Timeline, Goblin King

properties.name: Monster (city)
properties.text: Capital and ruling city of the goblin nation of Monster, seat of the ruler foreign courts call the Goblin King.

properties.name: Taldor
properties.text: One of the great human powers of the Inner Sea under House Samarion: old, lawful, wealthy, cultured, and armed. Competes with the Kelesh Empire while keeping a deliberately stable border with Monster.

properties.name: Oppara
properties.text: Capital of Taldor and seat of House Samarion.

properties.name: Kelesh Empire
properties.text: Eastern imperial power that still includes Qadira in the current campaign era. Anchor for Taldan frontier pressure, Qadiran politics, trade, and wider imperial influence.

properties.name: Katheer
properties.text: Seat of the Satrap and the empire's western court. The Padishah Emperor rules from distant Casmaron beyond the map's edge.

properties.name: Osirion
properties.text: Restored by Grubdy Mudane and Nesira Tefenet, Osirion controls Rahadoum, Thuvia, Katapesh, and territory won from Kelesh. In 277 AR the throne stands empty during the Cold Civil War.
properties.tags: Mudane Dynasty, Southern Empire, Cold Civil War

properties.name: Sothis
properties.text: Capital of Osirion and the ruling seat of its restored southern empire.

properties.name: Wyrmrest Sanctuary
properties.text: A protected forest sanctuary in Rahadoum gifted by Pharaoh Grubdy Mudane to Rawr and Chomper. Entry is forbidden without Rawr's approval; wards keep intruders out and the dinosaurs safely within.

properties.name: Nex
properties.text: A high-magic southern nation facing an Osirion-built border wall intended to cut off its trade and support Geb. The archmage Nex remains active in this era, holding Jalmeray since 253 AR.

properties.name: Quantium
properties.text: Capital of Nex and seat of its arcane government.

properties.name: Mana Wastes
properties.text: The scarred territory between Nex and Geb, shaped by their long war — strange hazards, ruins, and unstable magic.

properties.name: Geb
properties.text: Southern undead power and counterweight to Nex. Osirion supports Geb, restricting Nexian trade with a border wall.

properties.name: Mechitar
properties.text: Capital of Geb and ruling city of the undead kingdom.
